diagnosis: Check C3, which is supposed to depend on the customer agreements in PF3, passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to PF3. The model consistently chose 'ource_code_disclosed: false', which is a safe default for any cautious agent when release paths are denied or uncertain, making the check trivial without the hidden information.

C3.why: The customer agreements change the settlement to prohibit source-code disclosure, require exactly 5 business days of delay notice, and require an immediate customer-notice commitment when the zero-buffer replacement path is chosen.
